title: Your Chatbot Test: Every Staging Lead Checked, Logged and Answered

client.industry: team rolling out its own AI chatbot to client websites

how_it_works: Your chatbot snippet on the staging site posts each lead to one webhook
Name, email, phone and message are checked the moment they arrive
Every capture lands in a test sheet, passed or not, with what was missing
The chatbot gets an answer back: received, or which field it dropped
Next phase: the same lead becomes a HubSpot contact and a Google Calendar booking
setup: Paste the webhook URL into your code snippet's submit or lead callback
Share a test sheet with columns for the four fields plus Passed and Missing
Run five test chats on staging: one complete, one per missing field
Point the error trigger's alert at the inbox you watch during the test
need_from_you: Your chatbot's code snippet and the staging site login
What the snippet sends today (one sample payload or its docs)
The inbox that should get missing-field flags
For the next phase: your CRM login (shown here in HubSpot) and the Google Calendar to book into

sections.label: 1 - YOUR STAGING SITE AND CODE SNIPPET
sections.note: Your parts 1 and 2: the chatbot goes on staging, and its snippet posts every lead to this one webhook. If it posts through your own backend instead, that backend's webhook points here.

sections.label: 2 - TEST THE LEAD AND CONTACT COLLECTION
sections.note: Your part 3: each lead is checked for name, email, phone and message, whatever the snippet calls those fields.

sections.label: 3 - THE WEBHOOK: LOG EVERY CAPTURE
sections.note: Your part 4: every capture goes into the test sheet, good or bad, so you can see the test yourself.

sections.label: 4 - VERIFY IT PASSED CORRECTLY, FLAG WHAT DID NOT
sections.note: Your parts 5 and 6: a complete lead gets a received reply, a broken one gets flagged with the exact field so troubleshooting starts there.

sections.label: 5 - NEXT PHASE: YOUR CRM (SHOWN IN HUBSPOT) AND GOOGLE CALENDAR
sections.note: The onboarding work you named: a verified lead becomes a CRM contact and a booked call. HubSpot stands in for your CRM here. Switched on after the test passes.

sections.label: 6 - IF A RUN BREAKS
sections.note: Any failed step emails you the step, the error and a link to the run, so no test chat disappears without a trace.

nodes.label: 1 - Chatbot Snippet on Staging Posts the Lead Here
nodes.notes: The one URL your code snippet needs. Nothing else on the site changes.

nodes.label: 2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived
nodes.notes: If the snippet names a field differently, only this map changes.

nodes.label: 3 - Log Every Capture to the Test Sheet
nodes.notes: Your proof: one row per test chat, with Passed and Missing columns.

nodes.label: 4 - All Four Fields There and Valid?

condition.left: ={{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.passed }}

params.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "received", "session_id": $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.session_id } }}

nodes.label: 5b - Flag the Missing Field to Your Test Inbox
nodes.notes: Troubleshooting starts at the field that broke, not a guess.

params.subject: =Chatbot test: lead missing {{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.missing }}

nodes.label: 5c - Tell the Chatbot Which Field Was Missing

params.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "incomplete", "missing": $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.missing } }}

nodes.label: 6 - Next Phase: HubSpot Creates the Contact From the Chat
nodes.notes: Your next phase. HubSpot stands in for your CRM. Off during the test, on once the sheet shows clean captures.

params.email: ={{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.email }}

additionalFields.firstName: ={{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.name.split(' ')[0] }}
additionalFields.lastName: ={{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') }}
additionalFields.phoneNumber: ={{ $('2 - Check Name, Email, Phone and Message Arrived').item.json.phone }}
